title: Assessment
text: Home Assessment Assessment Berea's outcomes assessment process runs on a three-year cycle for academic departments, academic and student support services, and administrative offices. Each area below has its own process outline, report template, and review rubric. Academic Departments For departments assessing student learning outcomes (SLOs) in their majors and programs. PDF · 160 KB DOCX Curriculum Mapping Template Map where each outcome is introduced, developed, and demonstrated across required courses. DOCX · 21 KB DOCX Alternative Assessment Process for Externally Accredited Programs For programs with specialized accreditation that follow an alternative assessment process. DOCX · 23 KB Academic & Student Support Services For centers, offices, and services that support students, assessing program outcomes and objectives (POs). PDF Assessment Process Outline: Academic & Student Support Services How the three-year cycle works and what each area completes each year. PDF · 149 KB DOCX Annual Assessment Report Template The report form for the POs your area is assessing this year, with instructions. DOCX · 35 KB PDF Rubric for Evaluating Annual Assessment Reports (POs) The rubric used to review academic and student support services reports. PDF · 160 KB DOCX SACSCOC Standard 8.2.c: Academic & Student Services The standard and its rationale, from the SACSCOC Resource Manual. DOCX · 75 KB Administrative Offices For administrative and operational units assessing program outcomes and objectives (POs). PDF · 148 KB DOCX Annual Assessment Report Template The report form for the POs your office is assessing this year, with instructions. DOCX Writing Clear and Measurable Outcomes Ten suggestions for writing SLOs and program outcomes you can actually assess. PDF · 1.4 MB DOCX 100 Ideas for Assessing Learning and Program Outcomes A menu of assessment methods to choose from. DOCX · 22 KB Questions about your report? The Office of Academic Affairs can help with outcomes, measures, benchmarks, and the report itself. Email smithro@berea.edu .
